help.noResultsText: Try another word or contact support.
help.stillNeedText: Our team is here to help you.
help.profile.1.q: How do I create my FutboLink profile?
help.profile.1.a: You can create your profile from “Sign up”. Select the group and role that matches your profile and fill in the registration form. Once done, you'll get a confirmation email. After confirming your account, you can start completing your profile.
help.profile.2.q: How do I complete my profile?
help.profile.2.a: You can complete and update your information from “Edit profile”. There you'll find the different fields available to add information about your career and professional profile. FutboLink also shows a percentage indicator so you know how complete your profile is.
help.profile.3.q: How do I change my profile picture?
help.profile.3.a: You can change your photo from “Edit profile” or directly from your profile photo icon.
help.profile.4.q: How do I add my football experience?
help.profile.4.a: From “Edit profile” → “Professional” you can add your football career and experience. FutboLink lets you select clubs and shows their logos when they're available on the platform. If your club isn't listed, you can still add it. You can also purchase Career Verified, a one-time paid service through which FutboLink adds and verifies your career, including the corresponding club logos.
help.profile.5.q: How do I add videos to my profile?
help.profile.5.a: You can add videos by including their links, for example ones you have published on YouTube. FutboLink currently doesn't allow uploading video files directly from your device; you need to add the video link.
help.profile.6.q: How do I change my password?
help.profile.6.a: You can change your password from “Settings” or use the option available when logging in. To make the change, you'll receive a security token that lets you set a new password.
help.profile.7.q: How do I recover my password?
help.profile.7.a: If you need to recover or reset your password, you can do so from the options available in “Settings”.
help.profile.8.q: How do I delete my account?
help.profile.8.a: If you want to delete your account, write to us from the Contact section stating the email you registered with and your username. Our team will handle the deletion of your account.
help.offers.1.q: Where can I search for offers?
help.offers.1.a: You can find the available opportunities from FutboLink's “Market” section. There you can browse the different offers posted on the platform.
help.offers.2.q: How can I see an offer's requirements?
help.offers.2.a: To see all of an offer's requirements, select “See more” on the corresponding card. There you can check the opportunity's information and conditions before applying.
help.offers.3.q: How do I apply to an offer?
help.offers.3.a: To apply you need an active subscription. Once inside “Market”, select the offer you're interested in and click “Apply”. Your application will be sent to the recruiter or poster who published the opportunity.
help.offers.4.q: Can I apply to several offers?
help.offers.4.a: Yes. You can apply to different opportunities available on FutboLink as long as you meet the requirements and have an active subscription. The procedure is the same: go to the offer from “Market” and select “Apply”.
help.offers.5.q: Where can I see my applications?
help.offers.5.a: You can check your applications from your profile, in the “Home” section. There you can see your applications and the status of each one. FutboLink also has a specific guide explaining how applications work.
help.offers.6.q: What does it mean when my application is “Under review”?
help.offers.6.a: The “Under review” status means the poster or recruiter has already entered the offer's candidates section, but hasn't reviewed your profile yet.
help.offers.7.q: Who receives my profile when I apply?
help.offers.7.a: Your profile is received by the recruiter, club or poster who published the offer.
help.recruiting.1.q: How do I post an offer?
help.recruiting.1.a: You can post an offer from your profile. You'll need to fill in the form with the opportunity's information and requirements and add the corresponding image. Once posted, professionals who meet the requirements will be able to find it and apply.
help.recruiting.2.q: How can I find players and professionals?
help.recruiting.2.a: You can search for professionals using FutboLink's “Search” section. You can also post an offer and receive applications directly from interested professionals.
help.recruiting.3.q: How do I contact a professional?
help.recruiting.3.a: You can contact a professional using the contact details available on their profile, such as WhatsApp or email, when they've been provided by the user.
help.recruiting.4.q: How does the search tool work?
help.recruiting.4.a: The search tool lets you find professionals using the different filters available on the platform. Access and features depend on the corresponding subscription.
help.recruiting.5.q: How can I see an offer's candidates?
help.recruiting.5.a: From your panel you can access your posted offers and check the professionals who applied to each opportunity.
help.safety.1.q: How can I identify a suspicious offer?
help.safety.1.a: If an offer seems suspicious, check the poster's details and the published information. If you have doubts about an opportunity, you can contact our support team.
help.safety.2.q: What are basic and international offers?
help.safety.2.a: Basic offers are available to users based on their plan's conditions. International opportunities may be available depending on the corresponding subscription type.
help.safety.3.q: How does the featured profile work?
help.safety.3.a: Users with a Professional subscription get more visibility on the platform through the featured profile, making it easier for their profile to catch the attention of clubs and recruiters.
help.safety.4.a: If you need help, you can reach our team through the Contact section.
help.safety.5.q: How do I report a profile or content?
help.safety.5.a: If you find a profile or content you'd like to report, you can reach our team from the Contact section. Let us know which profile or content you'd like to report and briefly explain the reason for the report.
